WORKING: All 10 tests pass on completely fresh simulator
- App tests: launch, tab-navigation, settings, recording-view, onboarding
- Keyboard tests: setup-keyboard, activate-keyboard, keyboard-layout, keyboard-typing, mic-button

FRESH SIM FLOW: setup-keyboard → helpers/launch-app → activate-keyboard → layout/typing/mic

KEY PATTERNS:
- Each keyboard test (layout, typing, mic) runs activate-keyboard.yaml as a subflow to be self-contained
- setup-keyboard.yaml: taps toggle by coordinate (75%,50% on the row), handles 'Allow Full Access' alert via direct tapOn: 'Allow', idempotent via visible: 'Whisnap' check
- activate-keyboard.yaml: navigates to data: URL with <input> field, dismisses Safari overlays (Continue button, View Bookmarks tooltip via extendedWaitUntil), cycles globe until 'waveform' visible
- Keyboard text labels (from extension process): 'Whisnap', 'waveform', 'Space', 'Delete', 'Shift', 'Return', 'q'/'w'/'e' (lowercase)
